en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with two inset photographs from Glimåkra. The left image, labeled "Hotell," shows a large wooden house with a gabled roof, fenced garden, and lawn. The right, rotated image, labeled "Jernvägsstation," depicts a small railway station building along train tracks with a sign on the building. The word "Glimåkra" appears at the top in red. The bottom portion contains handwritten cursive text in Swedish, dated 1902.
